name: Off the page
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an extraordinary art-directed desktop homepage concept for Perry, a Mac companion that sees your screen, guides you, and performs tasks. Output one finished wide website screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape. This is a speculative creative design, not existing functionality.
Reference image: use ONLY the stick figure character identity from the provided image: imperfect dry black ink circular oversized head, exactly two small vertical black oval eyes, no mouth, simple black line limbs, expressive curious pose. Do not reproduce reference window or hello lettering.
Concept OFF THE PAGE. The whole website is a sheet of subtly fibrous ivory notebook paper. Quiet small top navigation: lowercase 'perry' at left; 'Meet Perry' and a small sun/moon symbol at right. Spectacular dominant typography: huge lowercase black 'perry' spans almost the entire width across the top middle like a confident Swiss graphic poster, partly printed on a gigantic paper corner that the tiny mascot is physically peeling upward. At center-right, a large irregular curling sheet rises into a sculptural arch, with believable paper thickness, bend, contact shadows and soft side lighting. Beneath the peeled page is a sharply focused macOS-like desktop fragment with a black top-edge notch, two file icons and an Archive folder, visually revealing that the character has escaped a drawing into the actual computer. The mascot is midway between flat ink and a standing paper cutout, pulling the paper with both hands, round face looking back toward us. Make this dimensional illusion feel astonishing yet physically coherent. The fold is the only big visual event; 45 percent calm paper space. One tiny pale yellow brush highlight, otherwise ivory, black and paper shadows. No rainbow app icons, tape, stationery props, decorative clutter or generic SaaS cards.
Lower-left strong clean grotesk headline exactly 'A little help.\nOff the page.' in black, about 64px. Subtext exactly 'Meet the companion that works alongside you on your Mac.' Smaller quiet lower-right black rounded CTA 'Meet Perry' with white type and a simple arrow. Tiny handwritten 'oh, hello.' close to the character. Premium editorial composition, tactile studio-quality paper illusion within flat web layout, extremely deliberate scale and whitespace, mature mischievous personality, no browser chrome, no outer presentation board, no explanatory annotations, no logo walls, no gradients, no chrome robot. Text clean and accurate.

name: The pop-up desktop
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a visually exceptional homepage design for Perry, a screen-aware Mac companion. A single finished wide desktop website screenshot in landscape 1536x1024, not a collage. Reference image supplies ONLY character identity: little dry-ink black stick person, oversized unfilled round head, two vertical black dot eyes, no mouth, no clothes, spare flexible black limbs. Keep this exact spirit; do not copy the reference layout.
Concept THE POP-UP DESKTOP. Build an ingenious engineered pop-up book of a Mac desktop, photographed like a museum-quality paper artwork, integrated into the hero. A large open ivory notebook occupies the right two thirds and lower half of the page in a low three-quarter perspective. From its central crease, precise white paper mechanisms rise to form an actual recognisable desktop: a slender upright window with macOS traffic lights, a black top-center notch, a folded Archive folder, and two fine paper file sheets. These are few LARGE coherent architectural paper structures with real hinges, tabs and scored folds, not a cluttered city, no tiny buildings. One expressive Perry stick figure stands on the page and physically lifts the edge of a paper window with both arms; its little ink feet are still drawn on the page while its upper body stands into space. A delicate continuous pencil path links the two files to the folder. Lovely raking daylight, microscopic paper fibers, soft graphite shadows, restrained yellow translucent highlight on one page.
Background is near-white warm paper, seamless with the website, no wooden table or lifestyle props. Confident clean grotesk black typography at upper left, exactly 'Your desktop.\nA little more alive.' with 'perry' small above. Under headline exact readable subtext 'Ask a question. Learn an app. Hand over a task.' and black rounded CTA 'Meet Perry' plus small arrow. Top right understated 'How it works' and sun/moon theme icon. Open notebook can bleed off right and lower viewport edges. A small handwritten 'I can help with that.' sits beside Perry. Beautifully restrained bookmaking craft meets precise contemporary typography, 35 percent negative space. Do not make a children's book, toy diorama, sepia vintage scrapbook or generic laptop render. No rainbows, gradients, robot, stickers, UI card grid, fake metrics, extraneous labels, annotation panels, browser chrome. Astonishment comes from one credible impossible paper mechanism, with elegant typography.

name: One line away
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a radical, beautifully composed desktop website hero for Perry, a Mac companion who can explain and act on your screen. Single landscape 1536x1024 finished flat website screenshot. Use supplied reference ONLY for the existing mascot: round black hand-inked outline head, two tiny vertical eyes, no mouth, minimal stick limbs. No imitation of reference UI or text.
Concept ONE LINE AWAY. Make the site itself out of a single living black ink stroke on expansive cool-white fine sketchbook paper. The dominant artwork is a massive custom fluid handwritten lowercase word 'perry', spanning from x=80 to x=1420 and y=200 to y=650. The word is bold expressive brush lettering, recognisable and exquisitely drawn with dry edges and natural pooled pigment; not a conventional font. The final y descender extends into a long physically plausible ink line that travels right, curves upward into the outline of a small macOS window, then toward a little stick figure at its upper corner. Perry is visibly grasping and tugging the loose end as if the line is string, transforming the static drawing into a useful screen. Tiny file and folder outlines inside the window are deliberately spare, with a pencil arrow circling a relevant control. A very small real-looking black Mac notch sits at top center, attached to the upper viewport edge; the line visually originates near this home.
Headline at bottom-left in precise compact geometric grotesk: 'A hand when you need one.' Body below: 'Perry explains, points, and helps you get things done.' Right bottom: clear black rounded 'Meet Perry' CTA. Small top-left wordmark 'perry', top-right text 'How it works' plus simple sun/moon icon. Accent consists of ONE pale lemon marker stroke behind a small part of the word, no yellow background. Great contrast between immense expressive ink typography and disciplined small interface type. This must feel like a world-class graphic identity with a living character, not scattered doodles or a generic education landing page. Whitespace plentiful, purposeful asymmetry, black ink weight carefully balanced. No paper tears, no 3D book, no photography, no human hand, no pens, no dark glow, no dashboard cards, no decorative stars, no logo wall, no fake metrics, no collage frames or design annotations. Draw the lettering with originality and elegance; mascot body language must be charming and legible.

name: The night shift
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a cinematic but restrained dark-mode homepage concept for Perry, the small stick-figure companion living in a Mac's notch. One finished website screenshot landscape 1536x1024, no browser chrome, no presentation-board framing. Reference image ONLY defines character identity: big imperfect circular head with two short vertical eyes, no mouth, simple expressive stick limbs; translate black ink into pale ivory ink on black paper. Preserve hand-drawn charm.
Concept THE NIGHT SHIFT. Black uncoated sketchbook paper fills the viewport, faint real charcoal fibers, tactile rather than sci-fi. A single immense horizontal precision-cut slit crosses the upper-middle area of the page, resembling an enlarged Mac notch and miniature paper theatre. Its top edge has two gently rolled paper lips and its lower edge casts a delicate deep shadow. Inside the slit, warm ivory paper scenery reveals a tiny quiet working desktop: a single folded paper Archive folder, two little paper files, and Perry carrying one file across a thin drawn line. Character clearly visible and emotionally appealing, about 180px tall, ivory outline head and limbs with two eyes. The slit has convincing hand-cut thickness, layers of black paper receding into depth, a warm pool of reflected ivory light but absolutely no neon bloom, stars, space or magic particles. Perry's head pokes just above the cut edge, breaking the boundary. Upper-left small ivory lowercase 'perry'. Upper right 'Meet Perry' with fine arrow and sun/moon icon. Below the central theatre in enormous beautifully spaced ivory grotesk lettering, left aligned on two lines, exact headline 'Someone’s still\nin your corner.' Subtext 'A little company for whatever you’re working on.' Small warm-ivory filled rounded CTA lower-right 'Meet Perry' in black type. One tiny handwritten note near the figure: 'got this.'
Ambitious optical paper sculpture with mature art direction, 50 percent negative space, dramatic extreme scale contrast between big typography and intimate little character. Use only charcoal black, graphite, warm ivory, and a pinhead of pale yellow on one paper tab. Typography should be crisp and refined, no rounded childish font. NO laptop hardware mockup, no robot, no robot eyes, no blue lights, no gradients, no floating glass panels, no UI card grid, no filmstrip layout, no decorative labels. Make the image feel like a nocturnal companion inhabiting the material of the web page itself.
